events.body:
## Context

`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-20-blt-documentation-modernization.md` isn't in the nav but is still built into the public site, with gitlab.com API commands. `mkdocs.yml` has `repo_name: owasp-blt/blt-docs` and a 2024 copyright.

## What to do

1. Add `exclude_docs: superpowers/` to `mkdocs.yml` (or move the file out of `docs/`).
2. Set `repo_name: BLT/blt-docs` and update the year.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No `site/superpowers/` after a build
- [ ] Header/footer show current names
- [ ] Strict build passes

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-docs && uvx --with-requirements requirements.txt mkdocs build --strict
```

---
